paths.entry: GitHub issue/PR search then full discussion and linked implementation/release
public web search then original engineering article and original linked discussion

selection_rule: Read first primary candidates returned by each query in returned order, preserve all screened records, deduplicate prior017 and withinB and laterA. Continue adaptive follow-up only by visible source links/actor-name/project-specific query, log it. Positive or negative outcome does not change B inclusion if genuine awareness statement and concrete choice are present.
strict_ignorance: Actor explicitly states not knowing a named alternative before earlier choice; proposition timing and actor role distinct.
strict_causal_chain: contemporaneous need/choice + at-the-time usable official option + decision-maker awareness statement + actual implemented outcome linked; retrospective only insufficient for strict causality
unknown_policy: Never impute private intent, zero cost, first internal awareness or implementation from publication/closed status.
freeze_note: 루트의 GO 이후 본 조사; 최초 모집문구는 수정하지 않고 실제 질의는 search-log.json에 보존
order_note: B의 sampling.csv 순번은 저장된 질의 묶음의 후보 원장 순번이며 A식 달력 연속 적격 순번이나 여러 질의 사이의 독립 순위가 아니다.
negative_extension_note: B07은 외부 도입/철회가 확인되나 첫 인지 미확인인 대조, B09는 생산운영이 아닌 공개예제 유지로 추가. 성공 목표 때문에 양성으로 승격하지 않음.
